title: PVF-10: A high-resolution unmanned aerial vehicle thermal infrared image dataset for fine-grained photovoltaic fault classification
mechanism: Public UAV thermal dataset of module crops with 10 fault classes split by repairability, plus resampling / padding baselines.
evidence: R: 5,579 crops, 8 plants; 5 DL models OA > 83 %, best 93.32 %; later work reports DINOv3 94.67 % and JEFFNet F1 93.21. Licence and download location unverified.
adaptation: Training set for the drone deliverable's module classifier; evaluate cross-plant on A3 instead of the in-set split.
min_experiment: ResNet-34 / ConvNeXt-T trained on PVF-10 + ISM, tested on A3 module crops (healthy vs induced fault); metric AUROC per fault type; kill the train-public-deploy-at-WattCycle claim if diode / interconnect AUROC < 0.7.
prior_overlap: Desk study listed thermal-only sets (D1 to D12); nothing trained.
